hero.title: Business Management in Finland – Bachelor’s and Master’s Courses
hero.subtitle: Experience world-class academic training and global career pathways in Finland with Edu-Hawk Worldwide.

overview: A Bachelor’s in Business Management in Finland can help students build a foundation in management, marketing, finance, economics and entrepreneurship. A Master’s in Business Management in Finland allows graduates to deepen their knowledge of strategic management, international business, business analytics and organisational leadership.

faq.question: Can Indian students study Business Management in Finland in English?
faq.answer: Yes. Finnish universities and universities of applied sciences offer English-taught programmes in international business, business administration, management and related fields. Applicants must meet the specific academic and language requirements.

faq.question: What is the duration of a Business Management degree in Finland?
faq.answer: Bachelor’s programmes generally take three to three and a half years. Research university master’s programmes commonly take two years, while professional master’s programmes may have different durations.

faq.question: What are the tuition fees for Business Management in Finland?
faq.answer: For the programmes listed in this article, annual tuition fees range from approximately €10,000 to €15,000, equivalent to about ₹10.86 lakh to ₹16.29 lakh using the indicative exchange rate. Some professional programmes have separate fee structures.

faq.question: Can I pursue a master’s degree in Business Management after a bachelor’s in another field?
faq.answer: Some universities accept applicants from related or different academic backgrounds if they meet the programme’s requirements. Others require a relevant bachelor’s degree or specific prior coursework. Always check the official eligibility criteria.

faq.question: How can Edu-Hawk Worldwide help me study Business Management in Finland?
faq.answer: Edu-Hawk Worldwide can guide students in shortlisting suitable universities, comparing courses and fees, understanding eligibility requirements, preparing documents and navigating the admission process.
